getStruct.text:
SELECT DISTINCT COLUMN_NAME AS col , CASE WHEN DATA_TYPE LIKE '%char%' THEN CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH WHEN DATA_TYPE LIKE '%numeric%' THEN NUMERIC_PRECISION - NUMERIC_SCALE - 1 ELSE 0 END AS data_len , CASE WHEN DATA_TYPE LIKE '%char%' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + RTRIM(CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH) + ')' WHEN DATA_TYPE LIKE '%numeric%' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + RTRIM(NUMERIC_PRECISION) + ',' + RTRIM(NUMERIC_SCALE) + ')' ELSE DATA_TYPE END AS sql_data_type , DATA_TYPE AS data_type, ORDINAL_POSITION AS pos INTO #t FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = '[%table]' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION
UPDATE #t SET data_type = 'C' WHERE data_type LIKE '%char%' UPDATE #t SET data_type = 'I' WHERE data_type LIKE '%int%' UPDATE #t SET data_type = 'N' WHERE data_type LIKE '%numeric%' UPDATE #t SET data_type = 'DT' WHERE data_type LIKE '%datetime%' UPDATE #t SET data_type = 'D' WHERE data_type LIKE '%date%' SELECT * FROM #t ORDER BY pos DROP TABLE #t

queryTable.text: select @@fields into #@@table from @@table a where [%whereFieldKey] [%updateRef] select * from #@@table drop table #@@table

updating.text: if exists(select 1 from @@table where [%whereFieldKeyOld]) begin select @codeExistsEditMsg as message, '@@firstFieldKey' as field return end

updated.text: update @@table set datetime2 = getdate(), user_id2 = @@userId where [%whereFieldKey]

inserting.text: if exists(select 1 from @@table a where [%whereFieldKey]) begin select @codeExistsNewMsg as message, '@@firstFieldKey' as field return end select @datetime0 = getdate(), @datetime2 = getdate(), @user_id0 = @@userId, @user_id2 = @@userId

beforeVoucherEvent_query.text: if @action = 'EDIT' and exists(select 1 from @@table a join sysinfo b on 1=1 where a.id = @id and a.ngay_ct <= b.ngay_ks) begin select '$VoucherLockedDay' as message return end if @@admin <> 1 and exists(select 1 from @@table where id = @id and user_id0 <> @@userId) and not exists(select 1 from sysmenu a where controller = '@@controller' and exists(select 1 from sysrightmenu b where b.user_id = @@userId and a.id = b.menu_id and (@action = 'NEW' or (@action = 'VIEW' and b.a_view_all = 1) or (@action = 'EDIT' and b.a_edit_all = 1)) )) begin select '$NotAuthorize' as message return end

beforeEvent_query.text: if @@admin <> 1 if not exists(select 1 from sysmenu a where controller = '@@controller' and exists(select 1 from sysrightmenu b where b.user_id = @@userId and a.id = b.menu_id and ((@action = 'VIEW' and b.a_view = 1) or (@action = 'EDIT' and b.a_edit = 1) or (@action = 'NEW' and b.a_new = 1)) )) begin select '$NotAuthorize' as message return end if @action = 'EDIT' and not exists(select 1 from @@table a where [%whereFieldKey]) begin select '$ListItemNotExists' as message return end

beforeVoucherEvent_inserting.text: if exists(select 1 from sysinfo where @ngay_ct <= ngay_ks) begin select '$VoucherLockedDay' as message return end

beforeVoucherEvent_updating.text: if exists(select 1 from sysinfo where @ngay_ct <= ngay_ks) begin select '$VoucherLockedDay' as message return end

beforeVoucherEvent_deleting.text: if exists(select 1 from @@table a join sysinfo b on 1=1 where a.id = @id and a.ngay_ct <= b.ngay_ks) begin select '$VoucherLockedDay' as message return end if @@admin <> 1 and exists(select 1 from @@table where id = @id and user_id0 <> @@userId) and not exists(select 1 from sysmenu a where controller = '@@controller' and exists(select 1 from sysrightmenu b where b.user_id = @@userId and a.id = b.menu_id and b.a_del_all = 1) ) begin select '$NotAuthorize' as message return end

beforeEvent_deleting.text: if @@admin <> 1 if not exists(select 1 from sysmenu a where controller = '@@controller' and exists(select 1 from sysrightmenu b where b.user_id = @@userId and a.id = b.menu_id and b.a_del = 1)) begin select '$NotAuthorize' as message return end if not exists(select 1 from @@table a where [%whereFieldKey]) begin select '$ListItemNotExists' as message return end

autoIncreaseCode.text: declare @q nvarchar(4000) set @q = 'declare @v varchar(32); select top 1 @v = rtrim(%s1) from %s2 where right(rtrim(%s1), 1) between ''0'' and ''9'' and %s1 like ''%s3%'' order by len(rtrim(%s1)), %s1 desc select isnull(@v, '''') as val' set @q = replace(replace(replace(@q, '%s1', dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@field)), '%s2', dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@table)), '%s3', replace(rtrim(@value), '''', '''''')) exec (@q)

getDirInfo.text:
declare @q nvarchar(4000), @i int select @fieldKey = dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@fieldKey), @valKey = dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@valKey), @i = 1, @q = '' while @i <= dbo.sf_GetWordCount(@fieldKey) begin set @q = @q + case when @i <> 1 then ' and ' else '' end + 'a.' + dbo.sf_GetWordNum(@fieldKey, @i) + ' = ''' + dbo.sf_GetWordNum(@valKey, @i) + '''' set @i = @i + 1 end
set @q = 'select a.user_id0, b.username as username0, b.nickname as nickname0, a.user_id2, c.username as username2, c.nickname as nickname2, convert(varchar(20), a.datetime0, 103) + '' '' + convert(varchar(20), a.datetime0, 114) as datetime0, convert(varchar(20), a.datetime2, 103) + '' '' + convert(varchar(20), a.datetime2, 114) as datetime2 from @table a join sysuserinfo b on a.user_id0 = b.user_id join sysuserinfo c on a.user_id2 = c.user_id where ' + @q set @q = replace(@q, '@table', dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@table)) exec (@q)
